shots.content: Inside a café, a rectangular table stands beside the window, with a tall floor plant near one end and the counter beyond the other. A woman in an orange shirt sits in the plant-side window seat and begins telling a story. A woman in a blue shirt sits in the plant-side aisle seat, and a woman in a yellow shirt sits in the counter-side aisle seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the counter end, looking lengthwise along the rectangular table toward the floor plant, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.

shots.content: A man in a white shirt enters and sits in the counter-side window seat. He asks why anyone would draw supplies from a dry well, and a woman in an orange shirt replies that the well was never empty.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: A woman in a yellow shirt asks how the story ends, and a woman in an orange shirt answers that the well provided everything needed.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot from directly above the rectangular table, centered on the tabletop, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.
